note: Her ruling of 29 October 2026 (chat, about 12:15 am ET, relayed on #1310; option 1 of decision 1 in the 28 October message, ledger item 73): (s3c), with its settlement terms read at leads 2 to 5 from the auction announcement and sized by net settlement, is the H5 candidate, named (s3c-ann-net). #1293 (#1288) scored it against (s3c): +4.8% [+1.4%, +7.0%] on the 2026 days and +1.7% [+1.0%, +2.5%] on the development window, development figures, not a verdict. The standings tables are (s3c-ann-net)'s own development walk (#1578, her ruling of 11 November 2026, option "own"), read from #1420's record, window development, beside B1, B1' and B2; before that they were (s3)'s, from #1145. Her ruling of 26 October 2026 (chat, ledger item 61; she merged #1256 that evening): (s3) carries the cap from full allotment onwards, and that is (s3c), named here by #1259. Before it, her ruling on #1151 (option 2) made (s3) of #1145 the candidate in place of #941's scaled mean reversion, arm (a) of #1115; (a) had replaced gbm_funding on #1115. Nothing is registered; registration remains her own action. The page reads the candidate from this file; the step 4 record is the fallback when it is absent. The gbm_funding walks were not supplied to #1145, so no row compares (s3) with it. Each evidence entry also links its page read on the studentized bound on mean d (her ruling on #1009; #1167, #1194); the candidate stays (her ruling on #1187, 24 October 2026), and its upper-tail twCRPS losses in 2020 and on FOMC days are an open question before any registration.
